dct_description_sm: Relief shown by hachures.; "Entered according to Act of Congress in the year [1855?] by J.H. Colton & Co. in the Clerks Office of the District Court of the United States for the Southern District of New York."; "Compiled from J. De Cordova's large map."; Insets: Plan of the northern part of Texas. Scale approximately 1:4,000,000 -- Plan of Galveston Bay. Scale approximately 1:1,000,000 -- Plan of Sabine Lake. Scale approximately 1:500,000.; Originally folded in cover.
